title: The Recruit token now sitting exhausted in player-1's base was created at step 32 by activating Herald of the Arcane's '[1], [Exhaust]: Play a 1 [Might] Recruit unit token' while a non-combat Showdown was (and still is) open at Abandoned Hall. The engine listed activateAbility in moves during Showdown Open state (step 31) and resolved it; the showdown is still unresolved at step 37 with that token
expected: activate-ability.ts:49 — `abilityTimingClass` returns "action" for any non-gear host card whose activated ability lacks an [Action]/[Reaction] tag (`getCardType(hostCardId) === "gear" ? "standard" : "action"`). The activateAbility condition (activate-ability.ts:513-516) feeds that into `isLegalTiming`, and chain-state.ts:208 makes "action" legal in `showdown-open`. Herald of the Arcane (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/herald-of-the-arcane.ts) is a legend whose ability has no keyword/timing, so it is classified "action" and offered/resolved during the non-combat showdown (trace step 31 moves list includes activateAbility with showdown.active=true; step 32 activates it, energy 2->1; step 37 Recruit token in base, showdown still active). Rules 308.1.a / 310.1.a / 313.1.a (and 145.2 for units) restrict untagged activated abilities to Neutral Open; only gear is handled correctly.
